info.name: Payroll SaaS API
info.description:
Multi-tenant Payroll/HR platform API. Authenticate with POST /auth/login, then use the token via the Authorize button.

---

**Setup**: Set `baseUrl`, then fill in `testEmail`/`testPassword` (collection variables) and run Auth > Login once — it auto-captures `accessToken`/`refreshToken` for every other request. Most "create" requests auto-capture their resource ID (employeeId, roleId, etc.) into collection variables that later requests in the same folder reuse.

**Known ordering caveat**: Leave Types > Delete runs at the end of that folder and will invalidate `leaveTypeId` before the Leave Requests folder can use it if you Run the whole collection top-to-bottom in one pass. Either run folders individually, or expect that one request to need a fresh `leaveTypeId`. (The API itself now blocks deleting a leave type that has any leave requests against it — a 403, not a crash — so this is a collection sequencing note, not a bug.)
